_template: Copy to app/src/main/assets/training_terminal/courses/<course_id>/course.json and fill it in. Delete every underscore-prefixed line - they are notes to you, not fields.
_id: lowercase slug. MUST equal the folder name. It becomes the branch name and the registry key, so pick it once.
title: EXAMPLE COURSE
_title: as the course is called on the certificate.
_version: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH. Bump MINOR for a content change after release, PATCH for a fix, MAJOR for a restructure.
_status: draft while it is being built; released once a class has been taught from it. A released version is never silently overwritten.
_modules: how many module_NN folders the pack contains.
programme: Programme document, revision and date - the accredited source this course implements
_hours: Hours are course-factory's business, not this skill's. Recorded here so the pack can be traced to its programme.
_published: Append {version, date, branch} on each publication. Nobody else edits this file, so it never conflicts.
_notes: Anything a colleague picking this course up would need to know.
